items.title: Pay doctor's invoice
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum unter Angabe der Rechnungsnummer.
items.computation: Rechnungsdatum is 26.06.2026. Since the period is tied to this date as the triggering event, §187(1) BGB applies: the day of the event itself is not counted, so the 30-day period starts on 27.06.2026. Counting 30 days from 27.06.2026 (27-30 June = 4 days, plus 26 days in July) lands on 26.07.2026. That date is a Sunday, so under §193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 27.07.2026.
